name: CAICA — Chicago Area Independent Construction Association
counterparty: Construction and General Laborers' District Council of Chicago and Vicinity

wages.exceptions: Employers covered by the CDCA agreement are excluded from these letters.

weekday.label: Weekday
weekday.note: Normal day is 8 hours between 7:00 a.m. and 3:30 p.m. Time and one-half for the first 4 hours after the 8th, double time after that.
weekday.note_es: El día normal es de 8 horas entre las 7:00 a.m. y las 3:30 p.m. Tiempo y medio por las primeras 4 horas después de la octava, y doble después de eso.

saturday.label: Saturday
saturday.note: Time and one-half for the first 10 hours, double time thereafter, running until 8:00 a.m. Monday.
saturday.note_es: Tiempo y medio por las primeras 10 horas, y doble de ahí en adelante, hasta las 8:00 a.m. del lunes.

sunday.label: Sunday / holiday
sunday.note: All work on Sundays and on New Year's, Memorial Day, Independence Day, Labor Day, Thanksgiving and Christmas is double time. No work on Labor Day except a dire emergency with the District Council's written consent.
sunday.note_es: Todo el trabajo en domingo y en Año Nuevo, Memorial Day, el Día de la Independencia, Labor Day, Thanksgiving y Navidad es doble. En Labor Day no se trabaja, salvo una emergencia grave con permiso por escrito del District Council.

fourTens.label: Four 10s
fourTens.note: The employer may schedule four 10-hour days at straight time only in a week with a designated holiday, no more than 6 times a year, and only if it is current on fringe contributions and working dues, has complied with every JGC or arbitration award, is not in violation of JATC rules, and gave notice to the union and the employees by 4:00 p.m. the preceding Friday. The days must be consecutive unless the other trades on the job work the same schedule. Past 10 hours it is time and one-half to the 12th hour, double time after that. In any other week, hours 9 and 10 are overtime like any weekday.
fourTens.note_es: El patrón puede poner cuatro días de 10 horas a tiempo regular solo en una semana con feriado, no más de 6 veces al año, y solo si está al corriente con los fringes y las cuotas de trabajo, ha cumplido con todo fallo del JGC o de arbitraje, no está violando las reglas del JATC, y avisó al sindicato y a los trabajadores a más tardar a las 4:00 p.m. del viernes anterior. Los días van de corrido, a menos que los otros oficios en la obra trabajen el mismo horario. Pasando las 10 horas es tiempo y medio hasta la hora 12, y doble después. En cualquier otra semana, las horas 9 y 10 son tiempo extra como en cualquier día entre semana.

premiums.note: Added on top of the base rate. Kane, Kendall, McHenry and Boone.

guarantees.title: You showed up and got sent home
guarantees.rule: If you report for work and are not put to work **for any reason other than the weather**, you get **not less than 4 hours pay** — unless you were told at least 2 hours before starting time that there was no work. If a crew is sent home, the employer has to notify the members or the steward.

guarantees.title: You reported and no work was provided
guarantees.rule: Not less than **4 hours** pay regardless of the time you actually work. And if you work more than 4 hours in any day, you get **not less than 8 hours** pay. Read that twice: a 5-hour day that was not rained out is an **8-hour** day on the check.

guarantees.title: Weather stopped the day partway through
guarantees.rule: This ladder is for **inclement weather only**: worked under 4 hours → minimum **4**. Over 4 and under 6 → minimum **6**. Over 6 and under 8 → minimum **8**. Any other reason for cutting the day short falls under Call-In Pay, which is more generous.

guarantees.title: Nobody called you off
guarantees.rule: The employer only avoids show-up pay if it phoned you before you left home, or posted a definite phone number on the site and required you to call in. Otherwise it owes **2 hours show-up time** to anyone who appears and cannot work because of weather. This applies to the whole contract.

guarantees.title: You waited around on site
guarantees.rule: Waiting time is **not less than 4 hours** at your regular rate. Past 4 hours it is paid in **whole-hour multiples** — but you have to stay on site and be available.

guarantees.title: You did two different jobs in one day
guarantees.rule: If you work more than one classification in a day, **the whole day** is paid at the highest classification rate.

guarantees.title: They worked you through lunch
guarantees.rule: An employee required to work through the eating period **shall nevertheless work at least 8.5 hours**, and that half hour is **paid at time and one-half**. On a three-shift job it is a full extra hour at the premium rate; on a twelve-hour shift, a half hour at premium.

guarantees.title: You got hurt on the job
guarantees.rule: You go for medical attention **at once**, and you are **paid for the lost time that day**. If the company doctor makes you come back for follow-up visits during working hours, that is paid too — up to 2 hours per visit.

guarantees.title: They started you before 6:00 a.m.
guarantees.rule: **Double time** for all hours worked before 6:00 a.m., unless multiple shifts are running. Start times can move between 6:00 and 9:00 a.m. at straight time — earlier than 6:00 is premium.

guarantees.title: They called a Saturday make-up day at straight time
guarantees.rule: Only allowed April 1 to November 30, once per calendar month, for rain, while tending masons — with written notice to the union by 4:00 p.m. Friday. After **40 hours** in the week it goes to time and one-half. An employer who breaks this owes **penalty double time for every hour worked**.

scope.title: Renewable energy work is covered
scope.body: The District Council and CAICA agreed to expand the branches of work to cover the renewable energy sector — solar, wind, hydrogen and geothermal power plants. The letter names the work specifically rather than leaving it to argument.
covers: Installation of the panel racking system
Forming, stripping of forms, backfilling and compaction of subsoil and topsoil at completed foundations
Filter cloth for access road construction
Offloading and unwrapping panel modules in the yard and in the field
Removal of packing material, wrapping and debris
Trench excavation and backfill for DC cable to the inverter
Trench excavation and backfill for AC cable to the transformer
Unloading, stockpiling, handling, distribution and placing of batteries in storage facilities
scope.note: The parties also agreed to seek recognition of this work and its rates under the Davis-Bacon and Related Acts and the Illinois Prevailing Wage Act — which is what puts these jobs on the county rate schedule.

fringeRules.increment: No less than one-half hour for each half-hour or portion worked.
fringeRules.grace: 30 days to submit reports and contributions.
fringeRules.penalty: Late contributions are assessed 10% liquidated damages, plus interest and the trustees' audit and attorney costs.
fringeRules.audit: The trustees may audit any participating employer's books and records.
